method: Browser-controlled Chrome against the vite dev server on 127.0.0.1:4222. Each surface mounts in a 1440x1180 iframe; the clock starts before navigation and stops when the harness sets data-capture-ready, or, for the two synthetic renders, around the exported production render call plus a forced layout. Three runs per record, median reported.

bundle.measured_on: the GUI's own modules served by vite in dev
bundle.why: The host screen reported CGSSessionScreenIsLocked=1 for the whole batch, so the native application was never launched and no release-bundle timing was taken. These numbers bound the client's own render cost; they are not the release figure and must not be quoted as one.

records.what: D1 cockpit, navigation to bound render
D14 audit page load, navigation to bound render
D16 Agent Board, navigation to bound render
D15 Plan Studio, navigation to bound render
Dock file read: cockpit with the Files tab bound
Activity rail Conversation -> Lane monitor, click to painted frame
Context dock Environment -> Files, click to painted frame
appendOrderedTranscriptRows over a 500-row Core page, plus forced layout
renderDiffBody over one 5,000-line hunk, plus forced layout

bounds_provenance: The bounds are this gate's own, stated before the runs and chosen as the point past which the interaction stops feeling immediate: 400 ms to a bound screen, 150 ms for an in-place switch, 250 ms for a transcript page, 500 ms for the largest diff the byte bound admits. Core publishes no event-to-visible budget for the GUI, so no bound here is quoted from a contract.
limitations: Dev-server timings, not release-bundle timings; the native leg did not run.
No event-to-visible p95 over a live Core, no memory profile, no soak, and no provider, MCP or LSP latency.
diff_5000_lines renders every row: DiffReview does not virtualize, which is why the record exists and why the number is the one to watch as the byte bound rises.
